name: og-image-module-tests
description: Build-output assertion suite for the og-image Hugo module, run against the five hugo builds of ./fixture -- the baseline, configured, degraded, multilingual and subpath environments. The module's output is a raster, so the specs decode the published PNG and JPEG bytes and assert what was drawn: dimensions from the file header, which background was composited from a corner pixel, how many lines of text were laid down from contiguous ink bands, what those lines say from a calibrated monospace advance, and where the overlay landed from its exact bounding box. It carries no dependencies -- node --test, node:assert and node:zlib are enough -- so it needs no npm install of its own.
